RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the July 26, 2006/Sravana 4, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions —20
Non-implementation of  Trade Unions
Act, 1926
*41. SHRI PRASANTA CHATTER-
JEE: Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to refer to
answer to Unstarred Question 1510, given
in the Rajya Sabha on the 16th December,
2004 and state the co-relation between
industrial backwardness and non-
implementation of the Trade Unions Act,
1926?
Increase in intrusion after withdrawal
of troops from Kashmir
†*42. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to the
decision to withdraw troops from sensitive
areas in Kashmir, infiltrations from across
the border have doubled;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether due to the lax policies of
Government, situation in Kashmir is going
out of hand; and
(d) the justification for holding talks
with the leaders of Hurriyat Conference in
Kashmir?
Review of military laws
*43. SHRIMATI S. G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to review military laws;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that in several
cases it has been noted that the punishment
was not commensurate with the offences
committed; and
(d) whether Government have received
any recommendation to review the military
laws?
Special Economic Zones
*44. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) how many SEZs are at present
operational in the country, State-wise;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

14
(b) how many SEZs are in the pipeline
and by when these are expected to become
operational;
(c) what tax advantages are being given
to SEZ units; and
(d) how much tax would have been
collected by Government if these
advantages/concessions/benefits would not
have been given?
Amendments in labour laws
*45. SHRI SHANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK: Will the Minister of LABOUR
AND EMPLOYMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government propose to
amend the Industrial Disputes Act and
other labour laws, in order to facilitate and
encourage foreign investments;
(b) the areas in which amendments are
contemplated;
(c) whether there was any proposal to
replace the whole of the Industrial Disputes
Act;
(d) whether the proposal is still under
consideration; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Social Security Scheme for
workers
*46. SHRI C. PERUMAL : Will the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to introduce
a National Minimum Social Security
Scheme for workers in the unorganized
sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Spurt of violence in J&K
*47. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Jammu and Kashmir is
facing a serious situation with Pakistan
renewing arms and money supplies to
terrorist groups in the State, resulting in a
sudden spurt of violence and infiltration
from across the line of control;
(b) whether the National Security
Advisor visited the State and highlighted
major lapses on the part of the security
apparatus, that led to the situation going
out of hand;
(c) if so, whether the Home Secretary,
alongwith top intelligence and security
experts, visited the State, to review the
current ground situation in the Valley; and
(d) if so, to what extent these steps
have helped in controlling the situation?
Disaster Management Authority in
Andhra Pradesh
*48. SHRIMATI N. P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Andhra
Pradesh Government has not yet set up
the State Disaster Management Authority,
in conformity with the Disaster
Management Act, to tackle the major
disasters in the State;
(b) if so, what are the reasons therefor;
and
(c) the details of disasters that took
place in that State since December, 2004?

15
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Export of stones
†*49. SHRI PYARELAL KHANDEL-
WAL: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of different types of
stones exported from different States;
(b) whether it is a fact that huge amount
of foreign exchange is earned annually
through these exports;
(c) if so, the details of the foreign exchange
being earned through such exports; and
(d) the State-wise details of exporting
agencies?
